title: Cancellation of Bogus Entries In the Record-of-Rights of Government Land Act 2009

sections.shortTitle: Cancellation of Bogus Entries In the Record-of-Rights of Government Land Act 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 2009
ACT IX OF 2009
CANCELLATION OF BOGUS
ENTRIES (IN THE
RECORD-OF-RIGHTS) OF
GOVERNMENT
LAND ACT, 2009
An Act to provide for
the cancellation of bogus entries
made in the record-of-rights relating to Government
land on the basis of forged documents or
in violation of law
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
10th November, 2009]
No.PAS/Legis-B-15/2009, dated
10-11-2009.---The cancellation of Bogus Entries (in the record-of-rights) of
Government Land Bill, 2009 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on Wednesday, the 21st October, 2009 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 3rd November, 2009 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is
expedient to provide for the cancellation
of bogus entries
made in the
record-of-rights relating to
government land on the basis of forged documents or in violation of law and
to provide for
matters connected therewith
or ancillary thereto;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(i) This Act may be called the Cancellation of Bogus Entries
(in the record-of-rights) of Government Land Act, 2009.
(ii) It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 1st January, 1985.
(iii) It shall extend to the whole of the
Province of Sindh.

2. Definitions.---(a) "Act" means the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967 (Act No.XVII
of 1967);
(b) "Bogus Entry" means an
entry made in the record-of-rights on the basis of forged documents.
(c) "Government" means
Government of Sindh.
(d) "Record of Rights" means
and shall have the meaning as defined in section 39 of the Sindh
Land Revenue Act, 1967.

by the Governor of Sindh on 3rd November, 2009 is

record-of-rights relating to

to provide for
matters connected therewith
or ancillary thereto;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
3. Power to cancel the Bogus Entries.---Notwithstanding
anything contained in any law for the time being in force or any agreement or
judgment or order of a Court, but subject to other provisions of this Act, the
Secretary to Government of Sindh, Revenue Department
specifically authorized by the Chief Minister Sindh
in this behalf, if satisfied, that an entry in the record of rights, made on or
after 1st January, 1985, is bogus, may without notice, cancel such entry and on
such cancellation, the land shall stand reverted to the Government.
